text: dsh-autostart 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端的 Windows 登录自启动插件。插件通过 Cordis bundle 注册；启用时将当前 DeepSeek Harness 可执行文件写入当前用户的 Windows Run 注册表项，使其在 Windows 登录时启动；停用或卸载时删除该项。非 Windows 平台不执行自启动操作。适合希望登录 Windows 后自动打开 DeepSeek Harness 的用户；不需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-autostart adds Windows logon startup for DeepSeek Harness. When enabled, it registers the current executable in the current user’s Windows Run key; disabling or unloading removes the entry. It does nothing on other platforms and needs no API key or external service.
想让 DeepSeek Harness 在我登录 Windows 后自动打开。
DSH 能不能随 Windows 开机登录自动启动？
dsh-autostart「Windows 登录启动」：启用时登记当前程序，停用时移除，让 DeepSeek Harness 随 Windows 登录启动。

dsh-autostart README · dsh-autostart：开机自启动插件 for [DeepSeek Harness](https://harness.deepseek.com) (dsh) on Windows.

启用本插件后，dsh 会把自身注册到当前用户的 Windows 登录自启动项；禁用后自动移除。

When the plugin is enabled, it registers the DeepSeek Harness executable in the current user's Windows logon autostart entry; disabling the plugin removes it again.

dsh-autostart README · What it does：| Action | Effect |
|---|---|
| 启用 Enable | Writes `DeepSeekHarnessAutoStart` into `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run` pointing at the running `process.execPath` (correctly quoted for paths with spaces). |
| 禁用 / 卸载 Disable / uninstall | Removes that registry value. |
| Non-Windows platforms | No-op — the plugin logs that autostart is only supported on Windows. |
dsh-autostart README · What it does：Only the current user's hive (`HKCU`) is touched, so **no administrator privileges are required**, and everything is undone on disable.

dsh-autostart README · Requirements：- Windows (the plugin is inert elsewhere)
- A DeepSeek Harness profile with plugin/bundle support

dsh-autostart README · Verify：```bat
reg query "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run" /v DeepSeekHarnessAutoStart
```

Expected (quotes are required — the install path contains spaces):

```
DeepSeekHarnessAutoStart    REG_SZ    "C:\...\DeepSeek Harness\DeepSeek Harness.exe"
```

Note: the autostart entry launches dsh at **Windows logon**, not at dsh restart. To test, sign out and back in (or reboot).

dsh-autostart README · How it works：`index.js` is a Cordis host plugin (`export function apply(ctx, config)`):

- On activation it runs `reg add` via `execFileSync` (no shell, so the quoting around the spaced path survives).
- Cleanup is registered with `ctx.effect`. Cordis runs the `ctx.effect` callback **immediately** and treats its **return value** as the disposer — so the delete lives in the returned function and only fires on real disable/unload.
dsh-autostart README · Uninstall：Disable the plugin (or `remove_bundle`), which deletes the registry value. Nothing else is written.

dsh-autostart README · Prior art：[`dsh-autostart` on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-autostart) ([Ghost011118/dsh-autostart](https://github.com/Ghost011118/dsh-autostart)) is a separate project that solves an adjacent problem: it autostarts **`dsh web`** with a hidden window and a crash-restart supervisor. This plugin instead registers the **desktop app** itself through the standard Windows logon Run key, driven by dsh's own plugin enable/disable, and writes nothing beyond a single `HKCU` value.
